query:
INSERT INTO contact_verification (
                    user_uuid,
                    user_domain,
                    credential_fingerprint,
                    verified_at
                ) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4)
                ON CONFLICT (user_uuid, user_domain) DO UPDATE SET
                    credential_fingerprint = excluded.credential_fingerprint,
                    verified_at = excluded.verified_at
